title: ISRO Conducts 'Mission MITRA' Astronaut Evaluation in Leh, Ladakh
summary: Human Space Flight Centre tests 4 Gaganyaan astronaut-designates under extreme altitude conditions in Ladakh.

blocks.content: ISRO launched **Mission MITRA (Mapping of Interoperable Traits and Response Assessment)** at Leh (3,500m altitude) testing Gaganyaan astronaut-designates (Shukla, Nair, Krishnan, Pratap).
